segments.name: Off-price retail
segments.description: An off-price retailer of brand name household products sold at steep discounts through no-frills, warehouse-style stores across the United States.
segments.evidence: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. and subsidiaries (collectively referred to as the "Company" or "Ollie's") is a leading off-price retailer of brand name household products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay retail prices for brand name household products at Ollie's stores, plus revenue from the Ollie's Army loyalty program, co-branded credit card, and gift card breakage.
revenueModel.evidence: Ollie's recognizes retail sales in its stores when merchandise is sold and the customer takes possession of merchandise.

changes.text: In fiscal 2024, the Company reclassified certain products from the Home category into the Consumables category.
changes.evidence: In fiscal 2024, the Company reclassified certain products out of the Home category and into the Consumables category.
